goal: Harden the complete AI Inbox Pro experience for a review-ready Vercel preview
context: Run only after every UI slice and the cross-route coherence pass. This task prepares, but does not deploy, the preview until the owner approves.
requirements: Add complete page titles, descriptions, canonical metadata, social preview metadata, favicon/app icons, and useful 404/error handling
Audit asset sizes, font loading, layout shift, lazy loading, caching/content types, and avoid unnecessary third-party requests
Run a final accessibility pass covering landmarks, heading order, forms, names, focus, contrast, reduced motion, zoom, keyboard, and touch targets
Validate route refresh behavior, broken links/assets, empty/loading/error states, security-sensitive defaults, and Vercel configuration without deploying
Record performance, accessibility, responsive, console/network, and functional evidence for desktop, tablet, and mobile
acceptance_criteria: All public routes load directly and on refresh with correct metadata, assets, and status behavior
No P0/P1 accessibility, responsive, console, network, broken-link, or content-type defect remains
Performance and accessibility checks meet documented budgets or have an explicit owner-approved exception
Preview configuration is ready for review but no deployment, credential use, or external publication occurs without explicit approval
